Subject: FW: Postgraduate Workshops on Literature Review

Registration for both workshops is essential.

Students should contact Vanessa van der Ham: p.smbpjcuoy@massey.ac.nz



Hi Everyone



Next week the Student Learning Centre will be running a number of workshops on writing literature reviews.



Workshop 1:  Literature Reviews - An Introduction

We begin with an introductory session aimed at students completing a literature review for the first time. The workshop is intended for students doing Honours and Masters paper-based degrees; however any postgraduate student is welcome to attend. Students who work full-time have the option of attending an evening session:



* Literature Reviews: An Introduction (Tuesday, 29 April from 5-7pm in QB2)



* Literature Reviews: An Introduction (Repeat) (Wednesday, 30 April from 12-2pm in QB2)



Workshop 2: Establishing and Maintaining Own Voice in the Literature Review

Later in the week we will be running an interactive workshop: Establishing and Maintaining Own Voice in the Literature Review. This workshop is aimed at helping Masters and Doctoral students develop an effective own voice in the literature review. The workshop will be run on Saturday 3 May from 9am-12pm in QB2. Students are encouraged to bring along samples of their own work for peer review.



Registration for both workshops is essential.

Students should contact Vanessa van der Ham: p.smbpjcuoy@massey.ac.nz



Students should provide the following details when they register:

* Student number

* Telephone number

* Course of study

* Workshop(s) they wish to attend
